# Host and directory

Read from the code: every public name below, its signature and its docstring. Import `igni_service` — defined in `igni_service.directory`, `igni_service.host`.

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`Directory`](#directory) | igni's directory, for one organisation. What `host.directory` is. |
| [`Host`](#host) | The floor a service stands on, for one organisation. |
| [`Member`](#member) | One member of an organisation, present or former, as the directory describes them. |
| [`Organisation`](#organisation) | The organisation a token names. |

## Host

```python
class Host
Host(
    org_id: str,
    *,
    notifier: Notifier,
    directory: DirectoryClient,
    agents: AgentWire | None = None,
    vm_profiles: ServiceVmProfiles | None = None,
)
```

The floor a service stands on, for one organisation.

Cheap to make: it holds no state of its own. Tokens, caches and the
HTTP client are the service's, shared by every `Host`.

### Host.org_id

```python
@property
org_id: str
```

The organisation this host is for.

### Host.notify()

```python
async def notify(*notifications: Notification) -> Delivered
```

Tell people in this organisation that something happened.

Any number of notifications, in as few calls as igni accepts.
Raises `IgniUnavailable` when igni could not take them after
retrying, and `NotificationRefused` when it read them and said no.
A caller for whom notifying is best effort catches `IgniError`.

### Host.vm_profile()

```python
async def vm_profile() -> ServiceVmProfile
```

Deprecated: `host.extension_vm_profile()`, which says what it answers.

### Host.extension_vm_profile()

```python
async def extension_vm_profile() -> ServiceVmProfile
```

What became of this service's extension's VM request here.

The request is the extension manifest's `vm` section; this
organisation's admin approves or rejects it. Answers the request's
state (`pending`, `approved`, `rejected`, with the admin's reason),
the profile an approval made and how many groups and apps have it.
Raises `IgniUnavailable`.

### Host.agent()

```python
def agent(producer: Producer) -> Agent
```

`producer`'s agent: send it messages, files and events, open chats (`igni_service.agents`).

### Host.send_event()

```python
async def send_event(
    producer: Producer,
    type: str,
    payload: dict[str, object] | None = None,
    *,
    event_key: str | None = None,
    expires_at: datetime | None = None,
) -> EventAccepted
```

Wake `producer`'s agent with an event for this service's extension.

`host.agent(producer).send_event(...)`, kept for the services that
call it. It reaches this extension's own chat in the producer's
igni, on their desktop or in their Fleet VM, whether or not anybody
is watching: it starts a run, or is queued for the run already
going. Pass an `event_key` to make retries exact. Raises
`IgniUnavailable` or `EventRefused`.

## Member

```python
class Member(BaseModel)
Member(
    *,
    user_id: str,
    email: str = '',
    name: str = '',
    role: str = 'member',
    status: str = 'active',
    super_admin: bool = False,
)
```

One member of an organisation, present or former, as the directory describes them.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | `str` | required | The member's igni user id: what a `Person.user_id` is. |
| `email` | `str` | `''` | Their email address. |
| `name` | `str` | `''` | Their display name; may be empty. |
| `role` | `str` | `'member'` | `admin` or `member`. |
| `status` | `str` | `'active'` | `active`, or `deactivated` for somebody who has left. |
| `super_admin` | `bool` | `False` | Whether they are a super admin of the igni deployment. |

### Member.is_active

```python
@property
is_active: bool
```

Whether they are still a member (`status == "active"`).

### Member.display_name

```python
@property
display_name: str
```

Their name, or their email address when they have no name.

## Organisation

```python
class Organisation(BaseModel)
Organisation(
    *,
    org_id: str,
    name: str = '',
    slug: str = '',
    tenant_number: int = 0,
    domains: list[str] = <factory>,
)
```

The organisation a token names.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `org_id` | `str` | required | The organisation's id: what `Person.org_id` is. |
| `name` | `str` | `''` | Its display name. |
| `slug` | `str` | `''` | Its short name, unique in the deployment. |
| `tenant_number` | `int` | `0` | Derive per-organisation databases and index names from this. |
| `domains` | `list[str]` | factory | The email domains it owns. |
